item.title: Someone voltage-glitched a CMP 170HX mining card into a working A100-80G, and it's ~1.18x faster than retail
item.description: Kate's writeup is wild. The 8GB CMP 170HX apparently ships with ~80GB of HBM onboard, just fused off. Software unlocks got people to 64GB. She used voltage fault injection to get past the fuse lock, the | why kept: inference
